[[File:Irena Roterman Konieczna.png|thumb|Irena Roterman-Konieczna in 2006.]]
'''Irena Roterman-Konieczna''' ({{IPA|pl|iˈrɛ.na rɔtɛrman kɔɲɛt͡ʂna}}; born 13 March 1950) is a Polish [[biochemist]] and a professor at the [[Jagiellonian University Medical College]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-07-07 |title=Telemedycyna z kosmosu – rozmowa z prof. Ireną Roterman-Konieczną |url=https://www.tygodnikprzeglad.pl/telemedycyna-kosmosu-rozmowa-prof-irena-roterman-konieczna-0/ |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=Przegląd |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Irena Roterman-Konieczna was born on 13 March 1950 in [[Kraków]]. She attended the [[Bartłomiej Nowodworski High School]], where she passed [[matura]] in 1968. She received a master's degree in chemistry in 1973 at the [[Jagiellonian University]], and her doctorate in 1985 at the Medical College there. Her Post Doc position was at Cornell University – Harold A. Scheraga group 1987-1989. Her postdoctoral degree (habilitation) was at Jagiellonian University – Medical College 1996. In 2005 she received the title of professor.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska: Polish Science database |url=https://nauka-polska.pl/ |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=National Information Processing Institute}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Irena Roterman-Konieczna - Studenci, pracownicy - Uniwersytet Jagielloński w Krakowie |url=https://www.usosweb.uj.edu.pl/kontroler.php?_action=katalog2/osoby/pokazOsobe&os_id=73741 |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=www.usosweb.uj.edu.pl}}</ref> 

<ref>{{Cite web |title=Semantic Scholar | url=https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/I.-Roterman/5289345 |access-date=2024-04-05 |website=Semantic Scholar profile}}</ref> 


She has been the head of the Department of Bioinformatics and Telemedicine at the Jagiellonian University,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Bioinformatics and Telemedicine |url=https://bit.wl.cm.uj.edu.pl/en/about-us/__trashed/ |access-date=2023-12-23 |website=bit.wl.cm.uj.edu.pl}}</ref> and an editor in chief of the ''[[Bio-Algorithms and Med-Systems]]'' journal. 

She is married to [[Leszek Konieczny]], who is a Polish biochemist.

== Works ==
Irena Roterman-Konieczna is the author of numerous scientific studies on the structure and function of [[Protein|proteins]] and [[Amyloid|amyloids]]. In 2020, she was included in the group of "2%" or "160,000 most influential researchers in the world".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Matejko |first=Bartłomiej |date=May 6, 2020 |title=Naukowcy UJ CM w gronie najlepszych naukowców na świecie (TOP 2%) |trans-title=Scientists of the Jagiellonian University Medical College among the best scientists in the world (TOP 2%) |url=https://wl.cm.uj.edu.pl/ogloszenia/naukowcy-uj-cm-w-gronie-najlepszych-naukowcow-na-swiecie-top-2/ |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=Jagiellonian University Medical College}}</ref>

Her publications include:

* {{Cite book |title=Simulations in Medicine : Computer-aided diagnostics and therapy |date=2020 |others=Irena Roterman-Konieczna |isbn=978-3-11-066721-9 |location=Berlin |oclc=1153548491}}
* {{Cite book |title=Simulations in medicine : pre-clinical and clinical applications |date=2015 |others=Irena Roterman-Konieczna |isbn=978-3-11-040634-4 |location=Berlin |oclc=945756581}}
* {{Cite book |last=Roterman-Konieczna |first=Irena |title=Identification of Ligand Binding Site and Protein-Protein Interaction Area. |date=2012 |publisher=Springer |isbn=978-94-007-5285-6 |location=Dordrecht |oclc=829751666}}
* {{Cite book |title=Protein folding in silico : protein folding versus protein structure prediction |date=2012 |publisher=Woodhead Pub |others=Irena Roterman-Konieczna |isbn=978-1-908818-25-6 |location=Philadelphia, Pa |oclc=847549847}}
* {{Cite book |last=Roterman-Konieczna |first=Irena |title=Statistics by prescription |date=2009 |publisher=Jagiellonian University Press |isbn=978-83-233-2741-7 |location=Kraków |oclc=797815860}}
